title: Sandbar Sunset | Stay On 30a – Luxury Beach Homes In 30a Florida
description_expanded: Welcome to 'Sandbar Sunset' your elevated coastal retreat, perfectly situated in the vibrant Prominence community along scenic 30A! If you’ve been dreaming of a getaway where everything is walkable, the beaches are sugar-white, and the vibe is effortlessly fun, you just found it. Located directly across from The Big Chill, you’re steps from live music under the stars, outdoor movie nights, incredible dining options, boutique shopping, coffee runs, and family-friendly entertainment. The energy is lively, the atmosphere is welcoming, and the convenience is unbeatable. This stylish and spacious 2-bedroom, 2-bath retreat was designed for both relaxation and adventure. Spend your mornings sipping coffee on the balcony before heading out for a sun-soaked beach day. Prominence offers two stunning resort-style pools perfect for lounging, cooling off, or letting the kids splash the day away. Four adult bikes are ready for scenic rides along the iconic Timpoochee Trail. Inside, you’ll find a bright, open-concept living space filled with natural light. The fully equipped kitchen makes dining in effortless, whether you're preparing fresh Gulf seafood or late-night snacks. The comfortable bedrooms offer restful retreats after long beach days, and the spacious layout gives everyone room to unwind. Thoughtfully designed for both connection and privacy, the home features a door on the guest bedroom side that separates the space, creating added privacy for guests and ensuring everyone has their own quiet retreat when it’s time to relax. From pool days and beach adventures to sunsets and live music nights, Sandbar Sunset places you at the center of it all while still offering a peaceful place to recharge. Whether you're here for family memories, a couples’ getaway, or a friends’ trip to 30A, this is more than just a stay, it’s your front-row seat to the ultimate coastal lifestyle. TWO STORY UNIT 1st Floor— Garage 2nd Floor— Kitchen, Dining Area, Living Room, 2 Bedrooms, 2 Full Baths, Balcony, and Laundry Room ACCOMMODATIONS: Sandbar Sunset comfortably accommodates up to 4 people: Bedroom 1: King with Ensuite. Bedroom 2: King FEATURES 4 Adult Bikes Resort-Style Community Pool Large Private Balcony Fully Stocked Kitchen Drip/Keurig Coffee Maker Smart TVs Beach Gear Blackout Curtains in Each Bedroom Built-In Custom Laundry Room With Full Washer and Dryer **WE OFFER A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM GUEST AMENITIES:** Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath towels | Bed linens | Pool Towels WALKABLE NEIGHBORHOOD AMENITIES -2 Community Pools (heated seasonally October/November March/April) -Beautiful cabana area with grills -Restaurants, Bars, Ice Cream Coffee Shops -Shopping -Amphitheater for Live Music, Movies More -30-A Bicycle Trail **Please Note: ** *Access to the WaterSound Beach Club is not included PARKING One driveway parking spaces available. For parking additional vehicles, the HOA requires vehicles be parked in the gravel street spaces on the South side of the community. Included are 4 bicycles for your convenience. PROMINENCE AMENITIES Prominence on 30A is centrally located and has a variety of on-site and by amenities that make this community one of the most highly sought-after vacation destinations in 30A. This community features incredible amenities such as: 2 community pools and a beautiful cabana area for grilling. *Heated Pool during the months of October, November, March and April* NEARBY BEACH ACCESS -Deer Lake State Park (0.6 miles west of Prominence) is the nearest beach access. This park has great amenities including: restrooms, parking for golf carts/bikes/cars, and a beautiful walk along a boardwalk that winds through the natural dunes leading to the beach. The State Park charges a “Day Use Fee” of $3/car or $2/bikes or pedestrians for access and parking. Alcohol is not allowed as it is a State Park. It is a bit of a longer walk from parking area to the beach, but it’s a beautiful scenic walk on the long boardwalk with white sand dunes. The State Park Beach is less crowded than any public beach access points. – Walton Dunes Beach Access (1.5 miles West of Prominence) has a small parking lot, but no bathrooms, and is located just west of the Deer Lake State Park boundary. This access has no steps-just walk straight onto the beach. One of our personal favorites! -Gulf Lakes Estates is a South Walton County beach access (1 mile east of Prominence). Small access that can be easily missed. Parking not available but easy bike ride to the beach. -Santa Clara is a public beach access located at Bramble Grove Place (about 3.5 miles). This access provides a lifeguard, parking and bathrooms as well as ADA access to the beach. THE BIG CHILL (FORMERLY "THE HUB") The community’s town center, called “The Big Chill,” includes restaurants, shops, and an amphitheater. The amphitheater includes a covered event pavilion and is a great place to catch a concert, sporting event, or a movie on the lawn. This location is perfect for family outings! Be sure to catch the farmer's market here on Thursdays! HOTSPOTS NEARBY The location of Prominence is perfectly placed right in the middle of 30a. Popular spots are a short drive away: Seaside, Watercolor, & Seagrove Beach to the west; Alys Beach, Seacrest, and Rosemary Beach to the east. Seaside is a short drive away and is most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater and neighborhood school. The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! HOUSE RULES *Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM *Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises. *No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including porch *No parties or events. *Must remain pet free. *During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi. IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVAL All guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver’s license and 2) a "selfie". Other things to note
